key_facts: MAJOR UPDATE July 24 (T+1d to Saturday July 25 Hungaroring FP3; Leclerc 0.15->0.26, Hamilton 0.14->0.25, Antonelli 0.29->0.17, Norris 0.09->0.10, Verstappen NEW 0.075 replacing Russell; sum=0.855, outside=0.145). Friday July 24 FP1 & FP2 + post-FP2 Bet365 qualifying odds (Formula1.com, Motorsport.com, Autosport, Sky Sports, Racing Post 18:09 UTC): (1) Ferrari dominated BOTH Friday sessions on single-lap pace — Leclerc topped FP1 (1:19.075 by 0.484s; stopped 7 min early with minor 'something broke' issue fixed cleanly for FP2), and Hamilton topped FP2 (1:18.729) ahead of Leclerc (+0.148s, who was blocked by Russell on his final attempt), nearly 0.5s clear of the field. Post-FP2 Bet365 fastest-qualifier odds flipped Ferrari to 7/4 joint favorites (~0.29-0.31 each devigged; combined ~0.60). Flattened modestly for FP3 run-plan/fuel/traffic variance -> Leclerc 0.26, Hamilton 0.25 (Ferrari 0.51). (2) Mercedes struggled badly on single-lap pace on the bumpy half-resurfaced track: Russell P5 in both FP1 (+0.991s) & FP2 (+0.933s, car 'dreadful'/'far from great', pushed to 14/1 in Bet365); Antonelli sat out FP1 (Vesti P7) and finished P13 on mediums in FP2 after Colapinto's red flag aborted his first soft run and rear-axle locking/oversteer ruined his second. Bet365 dropped Antonelli to 7/2 #3 (~0.175 devigged) -> trimmed 0.29->0.17 (still clear #3 given 6/10 2026 poles, overnight sim recovery upside, and guaranteed FP3 soft runs). (3) Norris P3 in FP2 (+0.499s, faster 2nd soft lap cut short by red flag; Vasseur flagged him; McLaren redesigned floor working) -> 9/1 #4 in Bet365, lifted to 0.10. (4) Verstappen P2 FP1 (+0.484s), P4 FP2 (+0.692s), 12/1 #5 in Bet365 (ahead of Russell 14/1) -> enters at 0.075. Outside tail 0.145 = Russell ~0.065, Piastri ~0.035, Hadjar/Lawson/FP3 variance ~0.045.
